headline: Police Ethics Tribunal Evaluates Irjen Eko Hadi Over Wiretap Case
seoTitle: Police Ethics Hearing For Irjen Eko Hadi
metaDescription: The Indonesian National Police has convened an ethics hearing for Irjen Eko Hadi regarding his involvement in the alleged wiretapping of the President.
aiSummaryBullets: The Indonesian National Police initiated an ethics hearing for Irjen Eko Hadi Santoso concerning allegations of illegal wiretapping against President Prabowo Subianto.
Komjen Hendro Pandowo is presiding over the commission, supported by several high-ranking police officials serving as committee members.
Police authorities stated that former National Police Chief Listyo Sigit will also undergo an ethics evaluation, though a specific schedule remains pending.
aiContextParagraph: The Indonesian National Police (Polri) has launched a Code of Ethics Commission (KKEP) hearing to determine the professional standing of Irjen Eko Hadi Santoso. The proceedings are centered on his alleged participation in the unauthorized wiretapping of President Prabowo Subianto. The commission is led by Komjen Hendro Pandowo, a 1991 Police Academy graduate with extensive service history, assisted by a panel of high-ranking officers including Irjen Agus Dwi Hermawan, Irjen Untung Widiatmoko, Irjen Arie Ardian Rishadi, and Irjen Toni Ariadi Efendi. In addition to the current proceedings, officials have confirmed that former National Police Chief Listyo Sigit is also slated for an ethics review as part of the broader investigation into the matter. While the force has emphasized that no special treatment will be granted during these investigations, an official timeline for the former chief's hearing has not yet been established by the department.
whyItIsViral: This story is circulating rapidly across four major news outlets due to high-profile involvement in an alleged security breach targeting the nation's leadership.
